page.overview:
Who is Roarface?

Roarface is a caucasian woman with a wolf appearance that fights Invincible. She tries to hit him but Invincible grabs her and throws her into a building and leaves her unconscious on the ground.

Superhuman Durability: Roarface possesses a degree of resistance to physical damage, as she was thrown into a building and emerged unharmed, but with enough force she can be knocked unconscious.

Claws and fangs: Roarface can use her claws and fangs in combat as she did in her encounter with Invincible.
